name: Surgical Strikes Doctrine (2016)
description: Paradigm shift from strategic restraint to punitive deterrence. Cross-LoC operations by Indian Special Forces in response to Uri attack, establishing new threshold for retaliation.

trigger_event.event: Uri attack — 19 Indian soldiers killed by JeM fedayeen

operation_details.target: JeM launchpads across Line of Control in PoK
operation_details.casualties_claimed: 30-50 terrorists killed; Indian sources claim significant damage

strategic_significance.threshold_crossing: First acknowledged cross-LoC ground operation since 1971
strategic_significance.deterrence_signal: Changed cost-benefit calculus for Pakistan-based terror
strategic_significance.precedent: Established template for subsequent Balakot (2019) and Sindoor (2025)

film_relevance.part_3: First-act climax; Dhar's familiar territory (directed Uri: The Surgical Strike 2019)
